title: 2-Week Peru Itinerary: Lima • Amazon Jungle • Sacred Valley • Machu Picchu • Lake Titicaca • Colca Canyon
description: The ultimate Peru adventure — from Lima's world-class food scene to the Amazon jungle, ancient Inca citadels, floating islands on Lake Titicaca, and soaring condors over Colca Canyon. Two weeks covering Peru's greatest hits with time to breathe at altitude.

activities.name: Land in Lima & Walk the Malecón
activities.description: Arrive at Jorge Chávez airport, taxi to Miraflores (30-40 min, ~30 soles). Walk the 6km clifftop Malecón along the Pacific — Parque del Amor with mosaic benches, paragliders soaring off cliffs, ocean views stretching forever.
details: 📍 Use InDriver or Uber for fair taxi prices
🏨 Stay in Miraflores — safest with best restaurants

activities.name: Museo Larco
activities.description: Peru's finest pre-Columbian museum in Pueblo Libre. 18th-century mansion housing 45,000 years of artifacts — stunning gold pieces, textiles, and the famous erotic pottery gallery. Garden café is perfect for a break.
details: ⏱️ Allow 2-3 hours
📍 Open daily 10am–7pm

activities.name: Barranco: Pisco Sours & Live Music
activities.description: Head to bohemian Barranco. Cross the Puente de los Suspiros, wander galleries and street art, then Ayahuasca Bar (restored mansion) for pisco sours and Peña del Carajo for live criolla music.
details: 🍸 Ayahuasca Bar for atmosphere
🎵 Peña del Carajo for live music

days.title: Lima Markets & Fly to the Amazon

activities.name: Mercado de Surquillo & Cooking Class
activities.description: Lima's best food market — exotic fruits (lucuma, cherimoya, camu camu), 3,000+ potato varieties, fresh seafood. Then a hands-on cooking class: ceviche, lomo saltado, and pisco sour making.
details: 📍 15 min walk from Miraflores
💵 Cooking class: $40-60, 3-4 hours

activities.name: Lima Centro: Plaza Mayor & Catacombs
activities.description: Grand Plaza Mayor, cathedral with Pizarro's remains, Convento de San Francisco with bone-lined catacombs holding 25,000 skeletons. Entire area is UNESCO-listed.
details: 💀 Catacombs: 15 soles, guided tours every 15 min

activities.name: Fly to Puerto Maldonado
activities.description: Evening flight to the Amazon gateway (1.5 hours). Lodge arranges airport pickup and 1-3 hour boat ride into the reserve. Arrive for candlelit dinner surrounded by jungle sounds.
details: ✈️ LATAM daily flights
🦟 Apply insect repellent immediately

activities.name: Boat Ride into the Reserve
activities.description: Board a motorized canoe deeper into Tambopata. Your guide spots herons, kingfishers, capybaras, and possibly giant river otters. Canopy closes in 30 meters above with howler monkeys calling.
details: 🛶 Waterproof bags for electronics
👀 Watch riverbanks for caimans

activities.name: Jungle Nature Walk
activities.description: 2-3 hour guided trek through primary rainforest. Medicinal plants, poison dart frogs, leafcutter ant highways, monkeys, and toucans. The Amazon holds 10% of all species on Earth.
details: 👢 Rubber boots provided
🔦 Bring headlamp for evening

activities.name: Nighttime Caiman Spotting
activities.description: Head out by boat with flashlights. Black caimans and spectacled caimans — eyes glow red in torchlight. Also tarantulas, tree frogs, nocturnal birds. The Amazon at night is thrilling.
details: 🐊 Black caimans reach 5 meters

activities.name: Macaw Clay Lick at Dawn
activities.description: Wake at 4:30am for nature's greatest spectacle. Hundreds of scarlet, blue-and-gold, and green macaws descend on exposed clay. They eat clay to neutralize fruit toxins. The noise and color are overwhelming.
details: 📷 Bring zoom lens — 50-100m distance

activities.name: Canopy Walk & Oxbow Lake
activities.description: 30-meter canopy tower for bird's-eye views — toucans, parrots, maybe a sloth. Then canoe an oxbow lake with giant river otters, caimans, piranhas. Try piranha fishing.
details: 🎣 Simple but thrilling — they bite hard!
🦦 Giant otters rare but possible

activities.name: Sunset River Cruise
activities.description: Golden hour on the river. Capybaras grazing, monkeys settling in, unforgettable sunset over jungle canopy.
details: 📸 Best photos facing west

activities.name: Final Jungle Walk & Departure
activities.description: Last morning walk — maybe spider monkeys or harpy eagle. Boat back to Puerto Maldonado (1-3 hours).
details: 🛶 Pack the night before

activities.name: Fly to Cusco & Acclimatize
activities.description: Fly to Cusco (1 hour) — from 200m to 3,400m. You WILL feel it. Afternoon for gentle acclimatization: coca tea, constant water, no exertion. Light walk through San Blas artisan quarter.
details: ⚠️ No strenuous activity today
🍵 Coca tea is legal and effective
💊 Diamox at Cusco pharmacies if needed

activities.name: Gentle San Blas Stroll
activities.description: If okay, slow walk through cobblestone streets. Craft shops, sunset from the church steps. Early bedtime — sleep helps acclimatization.
details: 🚫 Avoid alcohol 24 hours at altitude

activities.name: Pisac Ruins & Market
activities.description: Head down to the Sacred Valley (2,800m — easier breathing). Pisac: massive Inca terraces, temples, and one of the largest Inca cemeteries. The colorful market below sells textiles, ceramics, silver.
details: 🎟️ Boleto Turístico (130 soles) covers Pisac + Ollantaytambo + Moray + Chinchero + Cusco sites
⏱️ 2-3 hours ruins + 1 hour market

activities.name: Ollantaytambo Fortress
activities.description: The last living Inca town. Climb massive terraces where Incas defeated the Spanish. Temple of the Sun at top with six monoliths transported 6km across a river valley. The town's Inca foundations and working water channels are remarkable.
details: 🏔️ 200+ steep steps — go slow
💡 Stone water channels still function after 500+ years

activities.name: Evening in Ollantaytambo
activities.description: Far more atmospheric than Cusco for overnight. Narrow Inca-era streets, babbling water channels, illuminated fortress above.
details: 🏨 El Albergue — charming hotel at the train station

days.title: Maras, Moray & Train to Aguas Calientes

activities.name: Maras Salt Mines & Moray Terraces
activities.description: 3,000+ salt evaporation pools cascading down a hillside — in use since Inca times. Otherworldly landscape. Nearby Moray: concentric circular terraces the Incas used as an agricultural laboratory with 15°C temperature variation between rings.
details: 💵 Maras: 10 soles (separate ticket)
📷 Best in morning light

activities.name: Chinchero Weaving Community
activities.description: Quechua-speaking women demonstrate traditional weaving passed down for generations. Watch wool washing with saponin root, dyeing with cochineal insects, and intricate pattern weaving. Each design holds Andean cosmological meaning.
details: 🧶 Not a tourist show — these are master weavers
🛍️ Buy direct from the artists

activities.name: Train to Aguas Calientes
activities.description: PeruRail Vistadome from Ollantaytambo (1.5 hrs). Panoramic windows, dramatic scenery following the Urubamba River. Arrive, dinner, early bed for tomorrow.
details: 🚂 Book 2+ weeks ahead at perurail.com
💡 Vistadome upgrade worth it for the views

activities.name: Machu Picchu at Sunrise
activities.description: First bus at 5:30am (or hike 1.5 hrs). Enter and climb to the Guardian's House for THE iconic photo — the entire citadel below with Huayna Picchu towering behind. Circuit 1 or 2 for classic viewpoints. Morning mist burning off to reveal the ruins is genuinely magical.
details: 🎫 Book 2+ months ahead at machupicchu.gob.pe
📸 Circuit 1 or 2 for classic photos
⏱️ First bus 5:30am (30 min ride)

activities.name: Guided Tour & Optional Huayna Picchu
activities.description: Temple of the Sun, Intihuatana stone (astronomical clock), Room of the Three Windows come alive with a guide. Huayna Picchu (if booked): 1-hour steep climb with vertigo-inducing views over the citadel. Only 200 permits/day.
details: 🧗 Huayna Picchu: steep and exposed — not for vertigo
💡 Guides at entrance ~120 soles for 2-3 hours

activities.name: Train Back to Cusco
activities.description: Afternoon train to Ollantaytambo, then transfer to Cusco by van (1.5 hrs). Collapse into your Cusco hotel with the satisfaction of having seen one of humanity's greatest achievements.
details: 🚂 Book return train when you book the outbound
🛏️ Well-earned rest tonight

activities.name: Sacsayhuamán & Qenqo Ruins
activities.description: Taxi or walk uphill (20 min) to the colossal fortress of Sacsayhuamán — zigzag walls of stones weighing up to 200 tons, fitted together without mortar so precisely you can't slide paper between them. Nearby Qenqo is a mysterious carved rock shrine with an underground altar.
details: 🎟️ Covered by Boleto Turístico
📍 Best visited in morning — afternoon crowds pick up

activities.name: Plaza de Armas & San Pedro Market
activities.description: Cusco's grand central plaza surrounded by colonial churches built on Inca foundations. The Cathedral has stunning baroque interiors with a painting of The Last Supper featuring guinea pig. San Pedro Market is the city's beating heart — stalls of fresh juice, empanadas, cheese, herbs, and roasted guinea pig.
details: 💡 Look for the guinea pig in The Last Supper painting in the Cathedral
🍹 Fresh juice at San Pedro: 3-5 soles

activities.name: Chocolate Museum & Evening Stroll
activities.description: ChocoMuseo offers free chocolate-making demonstrations (and tastings!). Then wander the narrow streets as the city lights up — Cusco is magical at night with its mix of Inca walls and colonial balconies.
details: 🍫 ChocoMuseo: free entry, workshops available
📸 Night photos of the Cathedral from the plaza are stunning

days.neighborhoods: Cusco · Andahuaylillas · Raqchi · La Raya · Puno
days.title: Cusco to Puno — Scenic Altiplano

activities.name: Scenic Bus with Cultural Stops
activities.description: Depart Cusco early on a tourist bus to Puno (10 hours with stops). First stop: Andahuaylillas church — called the Sistine Chapel of the Americas for its jaw-dropping painted ceiling and gilded altar. Then Raqchi, ruins of the Temple of Viracocha with towering stone columns.
details: 🚌 Turismo Mer or Inka Express tourist buses include guided stops
💵 ~$50-60 USD including stops and lunch

activities.name: La Raya Pass & Descent to Puno
activities.description: Cross the stunning La Raya pass at 4,335m — the highest point of the journey. Snow-capped peaks, herds of llamas and alpacas grazing on the altiplano, and the air so thin you'll gasp. From here the landscape opens into vast grasslands as you descend to Lake Titicaca.
details: 📸 La Raya pass photo stop — llamas + snow peaks
🏔️ 4,335m — highest point of your trip

activities.name: Arrive Puno
activities.description: Arrive in Puno on the shores of Lake Titicaca — the world's highest navigable lake at 3,812m. The town itself is scrappy but the lake views are stunning. Rest up for tomorrow's island hopping.
details: 🏨 Stay near the lakefront — Plaza de Armas area
💡 Puno is a transit hub — the magic is on the lake

activities.name: Uros Floating Reed Islands
activities.description: Boat from Puno harbor to the extraordinary Uros floating islands — entirely made of totora reeds, constantly rebuilt as the bottom layers rot. Around 1,200 Uros people live on 60+ floating islands. You'll visit a family, learn how the islands are constructed, and maybe ride a reed boat.
details: 🛶 The reed boat ride is touristy but fun
💵 Full day tour: ~80-120 soles from Puno

activities.name: Taquile Island
activities.description: Continue by boat to Taquile Island (3 hours from Uros). This traditional Quechua-speaking community is famous for textile art — UNESCO Intangible Heritage. Men knit elaborate hats whose colors indicate marital status. Climb the 500+ stone steps to the hilltop for breathtaking 360° lake views and lunch.
details: 🧶 Men's knitting tradition is UNESCO-recognized
🏔️ 500+ stone steps at 3,950m — take it very slow

activities.name: Return to Puno & Overnight Bus
activities.description: Boat back to Puno (2.5 hours). Depending on schedule, take an overnight bus to Arequipa (5-6 hours, arriving early morning) or rest in Puno and catch an early morning bus.
details: 🚌 Cruz Del Sur or Oltursa overnight buses — go for cama (flat bed) seats
💡 Night buses save a day of travel

activities.name: Arrive & Explore Arequipa
activities.description: Arrive early morning from Puno. Arequipa is Peru's most beautiful city — nicknamed the White City for its sillar (white volcanic stone) architecture. Visit the stunning Santa Catalina Monastery — a city-within-a-city with colorful streets and cloisters where 450 nuns once lived in total isolation.
details: 🏛️ Santa Catalina: 40 soles, allow 2 hours
📍 Open 9am–5pm, last entry 4pm

activities.name: Bus to Chivay (Colca Canyon)
activities.description: After lunch, catch a bus or shared van to Chivay (3-4 hours), gateway to Colca Canyon — twice as deep as the Grand Canyon. The drive crosses the altiplano at 4,900m with vicuña herds and flamingo lakes along the way.
details: 🚐 Shared vans from Arequipa bus terminal: ~15-20 soles
📸 Stop for vicuñas and flamingos en route

activities.name: Hot Springs at La Calera
activities.description: Arrive in Chivay and head straight to La Calera hot springs — natural thermal pools at 3,600m with views of terraced mountains and a starlit sky. Perfect after a long travel day.
details: ♨️ Entry: 15 soles
⏱️ Open until 8pm, bring swimsuit and towel

days.neighborhoods: Cruz del Condor · Colca Canyon · Chivay
days.title: Colca Canyon — Condors & Terraces

activities.name: Cruz del Condor at Sunrise
activities.description: Leave Chivay at 6am for the Cruz del Condor viewpoint (1.5 hours). As the canyon heats up, Andean condors — with 3-meter wingspans — ride the thermals right past the viewing platform, sometimes at eye level. Colca Canyon drops 3,400m below you. It's breathtaking in every sense.
details: 🦅 Best condor viewing: 8-10am when thermals rise
📷 They fly incredibly close — no zoom lens needed
💵 Entry: 70 soles (Colca tourist ticket)

activities.name: Terraced Villages & Canyon Hike
activities.description: Drive back along the canyon rim stopping at pre-Inca terraced villages — Yanque, Maca, and Achoma — where Collagua people still farm terraces built 1,500 years ago. Optional: hike down into the canyon to the Sangalle oasis (3-4 hours down, much harder up!). Or take a gentler walk along the rim.
details: 🥾 Canyon hike to Sangalle: only if you're fit and acclimatized
📍 Yanque's church plaza has condor-dance performances some mornings

activities.name: Final Evening in Chivay
activities.description: Last evening in the mountains. Return to the hot springs if you like, pack for tomorrow's early departure. Reflect on two incredible weeks spanning jungle, mountains, lakes, and canyons.
details: ♨️ La Calera hot springs for a final soak

activities.name: Drive Back to Arequipa & Fly to Lima
activities.description: Early morning drive from Chivay back to Arequipa (3 hours). Quick visit to the Yanahuara viewpoint for one last look at the volcanoes framing the city. Catch a midday flight to Lima (1.5 hours).
details: ✈️ Arequipa-Lima flights: LATAM, SKY, JetSMART — from $40 one-way
📍 Yanahuara viewpoint: 10 min from the center

activities.name: Farewell Lima & Departure
activities.description: Back where you started. If time allows, squeeze in one final ceviche at your favorite spot, walk the Malecón one more time, or visit the trendy Mercado 28 food hall in Miraflores. Then head to the airport for your international flight home.
details: 📍 Mercado 28: upscale food hall in Miraflores — perfect for a last meal
✈️ Most international flights depart late evening

activities.name: Departure
activities.description: Head to Jorge Chávez airport. You've explored the Amazon rainforest, ancient Inca citadels, the world's highest navigable lake, and one of the deepest canyons on Earth — all in two weeks. Peru is a country that stays with you long after you leave.
details: ✈️ Arrive 3 hours early for international flights
🛍️ Duty free has decent pisco and chocolate
